findings.location: T050, T052, T054, T058 and correction dependency lines 224-225
findings.affected_requirement: QR-001, QR-003, QR-005, sprint-loop disjoint test ownership
findings.evidence: T050, T052, and T054 are explicitly declared parallel-safe, but all three assign edits to tests/Vulgata.Tests/PreparedPass1/Pass1ProductionExecutionTests.cs. T058 is also marked parallel and assigns the same file while its dependency group may overlap the other correction RED work. Calling these sections disjoint does not provide filesystem-disjoint ownership, so parallel test authors can edit the same file and RED evidence cannot be attributed to one sole owner deterministically.
findings.correction_outcome: Regenerate the correction RED task partition so every parallel test author owns disjoint files, preferably one dedicated test file per correction slice, or remove the parallel markers and state an explicit serial order with one sole owner for Pass1ProductionExecutionTests.cs. Keep every RED before its paired GREEN and preserve the complete QR and PRC3 proof matrix.

findings.location: T051, T053, T055, T057, T059, T061 and correction dependency/ownership lines 224-238
findings.affected_requirement: QR-001 through QR-004, PRC3-001, sprint-loop sole production ownership
findings.evidence: The GREEN ownership map assigns PreparedPass1JobRunner.cs to T051, T053, and T055; PreparedPass1JobExecutor.cs to T053 and T055; Program.cs to T051, T055, and T057; PreparedPass1Store.cs to T055, T057, and T059; and Pass1CodeLogicDocumentCommitter.cs to T055 and T061. The dependency text orders T051 to T055 to T057 but leaves T053, T059, and T061 as separate sequences even though they overlap those same production paths. Thus multiple dependency-ready implementers can concurrently own and alter identical shared seams, contradicting the claimed serialization and making the minimal GREEN boundary non-deterministic.
findings.correction_outcome: Define a complete dependency order across every GREEN task sharing a production file, or repartition files so ownership is truly disjoint. At minimum, explicitly order the JobRunner/JobExecutor work across T051, T053, and T055; the store work across T055, T057, and T059; and the committer work across T055 and T061, then update the dependency and ownership maps consistently without weakening each paired RED.
